## Composition

Principal public BeeUI exports used by this screen: [`Box`](/docs/components/box/), [`Button`](/docs/components/button/), [`Card`](/docs/components/card/), [`Chip`](/docs/components/chip/), [`ChipGroup`](/docs/components/chip/), [`EmptyState`](/docs/components/state-message/), [`HStack`](/docs/components/stack/), [`SearchInput`](/docs/components/search-input/), [`Skeleton`](/docs/components/skeleton/), [`Text`](/docs/components/text/), [`VStack`](/docs/components/stack/).

The pattern is a composition recipe rather than a new framework layer. Follow the linked component contracts for state, provider, platform and accessibility details.

## State and callback contract

The screen is controlled through `ProductSearchScreenProps`. User intent crosses the application boundary through `onFavorite`, `onFilterPress`, `onProductSelect`, `onSortPress`; fetching, routing, persistence and side effects remain application-owned.

```tsx
export type ProductSearchScreenProps = {
  initialQuery?: string;
  mode?: ProductSearchMode;
  onFavorite?: (product: Product) => void;
  onFilterPress?: () => void;
  onProductSelect?: (product: Product) => void;
  onSortPress?: () => void;
};
```

Common product states such as loading, success, empty, error, permission-like recovery, filtering/search/selection or pagination are represented only where the actual screen source exposes them. The pattern docs do not invent backend states that the fixture does not render.

## Responsive contract

Read from the screen file and the 6 pattern-local files in its runtime import closure, direct and transitive: `product-search-screen.tsx`, `price-row.tsx`, `product-card.tsx`, `product-image.tsx`, `rating-summary.tsx`, `screen-shell.tsx`, `commerce-fixtures.ts`. Every fact below is scoped to those files and to nothing else.

- **BeeUI layout primitives rendered:** `Box` (`product-image.tsx`, `product-search-screen.tsx`, `screen-shell.tsx`), `HStack` (`price-row.tsx`, `product-search-screen.tsx`, `rating-summary.tsx`), `Screen` (`screen-shell.tsx`), `VStack` (`product-card.tsx`, `product-image.tsx`, `product-search-screen.tsx`, `screen-shell.tsx`).
- **Scroll ownership:** `ScrollView` (`screen-shell.tsx`).
- **Horizontal scrolling:** no `horizontal` scroll container in `product-search-screen.tsx`, `price-row.tsx`, `product-card.tsx`, `product-image.tsx`, `rating-summary.tsx`, `screen-shell.tsx`, `commerce-fixtures.ts`.
- **Width constraint:** `max-w-2xl` (`screen-shell.tsx`), `max-w-3xl` (`screen-shell.tsx`).
- **Breakpoint-prefixed utility classes:** none in `product-search-screen.tsx`, `price-row.tsx`, `product-card.tsx`, `product-image.tsx`, `rating-summary.tsx`, `screen-shell.tsx`, `commerce-fixtures.ts`.
- **Platform-prefixed utility classes:** `web:px-6` (`screen-shell.tsx`).
- **Platform branching:** no `Platform.OS` or `Platform.select` call in `product-search-screen.tsx`, `price-row.tsx`, `product-card.tsx`, `product-image.tsx`, `rating-summary.tsx`, `screen-shell.tsx`, `commerce-fixtures.ts`.
- **Viewport measurement:** no `useWindowDimensions`, `Dimensions.get` or breakpoint hook in `product-search-screen.tsx`, `price-row.tsx`, `product-card.tsx`, `product-image.tsx`, `rating-summary.tsx`, `screen-shell.tsx`, `commerce-fixtures.ts`.

BeeUI's [mobile-first responsive contract](/docs/responsive/) is the framework-level document; the list above states only what this screen's own files declare, and says nothing about how the composed components behave internally.

## Application ownership boundary

**Intentionally excluded:** Search execution, sorting/filtering logic, and data fetching.

BeeUI does not take ownership of app routing, authentication/business rules, APIs/data fetching, persistence, form/state frameworks, chart frameworks or backend logic merely because a pattern visually composes those product concepts.

## Source ownership

`ProductSearchScreen` is **Showcase source you copy**, not a package export: it is not shipped from any `@beemvp/beeui-*` package, and the Registry CLI (`pnpm beeui list` / `pnpm beeui add`) does not carry pattern screens. Copy [`apps/showcase/patterns/commerce-social/screens/product-search-screen.tsx`](https://github.com/beobungbu/BeeUI/blob/main/apps/showcase/patterns/commerce-social/screens/product-search-screen.tsx) into your app and adapt it directly. Only the individual BeeUI components it composes (linked above) are available for source ownership through the repository-local Registry workflow; before public CLI publication, use [CLI & source ownership](/docs/guides/cli-source-ownership/) from a BeeUI checkout rather than a public `npx` command.
